summary: Extended the probe's heal window from two to eight seconds and added a direct agreement check, and the durability question flipped from a negative to a witnessed violation on the evidence. Short window (receipt 4e9eaa72cf594018b8414a8d8efb7cb3, retained): both acknowledged entries survived in their own logs two seconds after healing and no node applied an entry absent from its own log. Longer window and a new operand: eight seconds after healing, the isolated node and the majority-side leader still hold different entries at the same log index (logs_differ_at_conflict_index true on the flagged case, false for the control) while both sides had earlier acknowledged their writes — so the entries are not lost from either log, but the two replicas permanently disagree at that index, each holding the write its own client was told had succeeded. That successor experiment is submitted for a receipt with the window change and the new comparison plus control, the short-window negative is kept as an earlier bounded observation, and the whole-question account remains violated with defect_claim asserted on the four established comparisons (configuration loss 15/18; minority election 22/25; single-side acknowledgement 27/29; two-sided acknowledgement 27/29) with the agreement violation marked as asserted from the probe pending its receipt.
